_comment: Minified identifiers in the pinned upstream bundle. Stable ONLY for upstream SHA a561c9f0...7631. Rendered into docs-internal/ARCHITECTURE.md by make_docs.py.

upstream.zge: Current Level card - per-medication breakdown and total
upstream.Ege: dose-array mapping - dosesByMed, halfLifeByMed, medication colours
upstream.Pge: dose chart axis, today index and zoom window
upstream.Rge: weight chart component and option builder
upstream.kge: weight stats helper - sorted data, min/max, padding, displayDate
upstream.Oge: old weight zoom helper, superseded by __glpalWeightZoom
upstream.Hge: Performance Overview, now a single Time Active card
upstream.Wye: dosing-plan hook - next due, cost, countdown; currentLevel always 0 since patch 23
upstream.SM: weight statistics class - BMI, averages, best week/month
upstream.xW: delete a dose record (upstream deleted from weights - patch 1)
upstream.ff: strip parenthetical from a medication name
upstream.Ht: clock and date helpers - now, nowDate, parseLocalDate, todayString

ours.__glpalUpdateDose: transactional dose update across a compound-key change (patch 1)
ours.__glpalOpenDoseEditor: Edit Dose modal, built with direct DOM APIs (patch 3)
ours.__glpalLocalDate: parse YYYY-MM-DD as local midnight for display (patch 7)
ours.__glpalWeightZoom: weight chart period window from the rendered axis (patch 12)
ours.__glpalMk: current-level marker series on the dose chart (patch 13)
ours.__glpalSampleAt: sample today at the current time, other days at midnight (patch 14)
ours.__glpalTmax: Tmax lookup from the stored half-life (patch 20)
ours.__glpalKa: memoised bisection solving ka so the peak lands at Tmax (patch 20)
ours.__glpalDayKey: year-qualified chart axis category, unique per calendar day (patch 21)
ours.__glpalDayLabel: strip the year for axis tick display (patch 21)
ours.__glpalDoseAt: dose record to a Date at its recorded time, local midnight if none (patch 22)
